sample: E = square arms of the 2026-10-02 indicator-levels study ($10+, 09:40-15:30, same sessions as order_block_gate / sr_range_trade / sr_gap_wr60_arm): ai_reports/indicator_levels/rows.json + ext.pkl (1-min premarket+RTH SIP). Opens kept as-is: every E arm with a usable bar series and a charted resistance bottom strictly above the entry price. These days were mined for entries/levels; never for this resistance-exit rule.
halves: chronological: first half of sample days vs second half (not alternate days)
entry: keep opens as-is: E square arm at decision close t; buy at the next bar's open (same as the levels study)
signal_exit: target = bottom of the nearest charted resistance block above entry (unbroken bearish OB or bullish breaker), known at the entry bar's open from blocks with known_ts <= entry time; filled when a later bar's HIGH is strictly above the target (fill at target). Time stop: close of the bar at 30 min after entry or 15:55 ET, whichever first. PRIMARY has no support stop (exit-only at resistance).
control_exit: no-S/R exit on the SAME opens and the SAME time stop (exit at the close of the bar at min(30 min, 15:55)); no resistance target, no support stop. Isolates the resistance take-profit from hold length.
optional_stop_info: information only: same as signal but also stop on a 1-min CLOSE below the bottom of the nearest charted support below entry (unbroken bullish OB or bearish breaker), sold at the NEXT bar's open; stop wins a same-bar tie with the target
cost: 0.20% round trip ($10+ tier, same as sibling studies). Measured RT spread = mean(gross − net) of signal entries in the half (= 20 bp under this model).
pass: in BOTH chronological halves: (signal mean gross − control mean gross) > measured round-trip spread of that half's signal entries, AND >= 50 paired trades per half. Also report net after costs (informative; not the pass bar). Fewer than 50 in a half -> UNDERPOWERED. Any PASS = PENDING SKEPTIC REVIEW (not a live exit change; SIP result does not transfer to IEX without held-out confirmation).
information_only: with support stop (optional stop under support)
F = desk fills ($10+, since 9/23) under the same exit rules (features from last bar closed before fill)
